findings.claim: src/ui/finish-panel.ts is dead code: no file in src/ imports it since the results screen (B02) replaced it, and only two existing tests import createFinishPanel. Its CSS (.ui-finish__card, .ui-finish__stats, .ui-finish__stat in screens.css) is dead with it, because nothing else uses those classes.
findings.evidence: Grep for `finish-panel` in src/ finds nothing that imports it. Imports exist only in tests/ui/screens.test.ts:3 `import { createFinishPanel } from '../../src/ui/finish-panel.ts';` and tests/ui/no-inline-colour.test.ts:6 (the same import). race-ui.ts:10 uses createResultsScreen. The classes `ui-finish__card` (finish-panel.ts:31), `ui-finish__stats` (:34) and `ui-finish__stat` (:35-36) appear only in that file, so screens.css:62-81 (`.ui-finish__card {…} .ui-finish__stats {…} .ui-finish__stat {…}`) is dead CSS. The bare `ui-finish` class must stay: results-screen.ts:64 sets it, and tests/ui/results-screen.test.ts:34 and tests/ui/race-ui.test.ts:16 check it.
findings.suggestedFix: Owner: delete src/ui/finish-panel.ts and the .ui-finish__* rules at screens.css:62-81. Retarget or delete the createFinishPanel cases in tests/ui/screens.test.ts and tests/ui/no-inline-colour.test.ts (no-inline-colour could render createResultsScreen instead). Keep the `ui-finish` class on the results overlay.

findings.claim: CLAUDE.md says race-ui.ts produces 'finish-panel updates', but race-ui.ts shows the results screen and never uses the finish panel. A feature night that reads this would look in the dead finish-panel.ts instead of results-screen.ts.
findings.evidence: CLAUDE.md:39: "- `src/ui/race-ui.ts` turns each frame's `RaceView` into HUD, countdown and finish-panel updates." Meanwhile src/ui/race-ui.ts:10 has `import { createResultsScreen } from './results-screen.ts';` and :112-120 calls `results.update(...)` / `results.show(...)` when the phase is 'finished'. race-ui.ts:1 itself lists the parts as "HUD, countdown, touch controls, results and pause screens".
findings.suggestedFix: Sunday edit to CLAUDE.md:39: "…into HUD, countdown, pause-screen and results-screen updates."

findings.claim: The button type and press-transition block (font-family, font-size, font-weight, font-style, line-height, text-transform, transition) is copied word for word in .ui-button and .ui-tc. clones.md flags it.
findings.suggestedFix: In components.css, move these declarations into a grouped rule `.ui-button, .ui-tc { … }` placed where they are now, before .ui-button--primary. Delete them from .ui-tc in touch-controls.css. Every later override (.ui-button--primary, .ui-tc--gas, .ui-tc.is-resting `transition: none`, the :active and is-pressed transition-duration) has equal or higher specificity and comes later, so computed styles don't change. touch-controls.ts already imports components.css before touch-controls.css. Note that open PR #24 also edits components.css.

findings.claim: The full-width 4:2:1 stripe band (flex 1/4/2, width auto, height s3) is written twice, once for the pause card and once for the results screen. Only border-width differs.
findings.suggestedFix: In screens.css, group the shared declarations: `.ui-pause__stripes .ui-stripe, .ui-results > .ui-stripes .ui-stripe { flex: 1; width: auto; height: var(--space-s3); }`, do the same for the --red (flex 4) and --mustard (flex 2) rules, and keep the two border-width declarations in their own rules. Each selector in a group keeps its own specificity, and no other rule sets flex, width or height on these elements, so computed styles stay the same.
